title: Writer Assistant Core candidate storage contract and evidence/provenance validation
goal: Define and validate Writer Assistant Core candidate storage, source locator, evidence, provenance, status, owner decision, destination, confidence, and path-safety contracts before extraction runtime, routes, UI, model calls, storage writes, apply-promotion, or memory/canon mutation exists.
why_now: PHASE8-IMPL-001 completed the first Writer Assistant Core runtime slice with tests-first schema contract coverage and minimal constants-only candidate schema metadata. The next safe slice is storage/evidence validation contracts before runtime extraction, storage writes, routes, UI, or model behavior expand.

include: Storage path contract, without writes at first.
Owner decision, status, and destination fields.
exclude: Runtime extraction and candidate extraction from owner text.
Backend extraction routes and frontend extraction UI.
Story Check auto-runs, semantic search, and Dramatica analysis.
Generated prose, rewriting, continuation, style imitation, prose improvement, or summaries as durable truth.
Apply-promotion, OMI candidate promotion, and memory/canon mutation.
Backend approved-memory routes/helpers and frontend approved-memory API helpers.
Training data, JSONL records, dataset manifests, model artifacts, and project runtime artifacts.

quality_notes: T001 publishes the parent and child plan only.
PHASE8-IMPL-001 added constants-only schema metadata and did not add extraction, storage writes, routes, UI, model calls, apply-promotion, or memory/canon mutation.
PHASE8-IMPL-002 starts with contract decision and tests before validation helpers or storage helper skeletons.
Storage writes remain disallowed in T001 and conditional later.

acceptance_criteria: PHASE8-IMPL-002 is published as the active Writer Assistant Core parent after completed PHASE8-IMPL-001.
PHASE8-IMPL-002-T001 publishes the parent, inventory, enrichment JSON, and roadmap/status updates.
PHASE8-IMPL-002-T002 is identified as the next child task.
Child tasks T001-T007 are documented with tests-first sequencing.
Scope explicitly prioritizes candidate storage contracts and evidence/provenance validation before extraction/runtime expansion.
Non-scope explicitly blocks extraction, routes, UI, model calls, storage writes in T001, apply-promotion, and memory/canon mutation.
No runtime code, tests, package files, backend/frontend files, project runtime files, training data, JSONL records, or dataset artifacts are changed in T001.

commands: non-LeanCTX whitespace check on changed docs
validation.notes: T001 validation is roadmap/status only. Do not run pytest unless runtime code or tests were accidentally changed.

safety_notes: No generated prose, rewriting, continuation, style imitation, prose improvement, or summaries as durable truth.
Storage validity does not prove story truth.
Evidence/provenance validation supports review only and does not approve or promote candidates.
OMI remains the central review and future promotion layer.
Promotion records remain audit-only until future apply-promotion exists.
Memory/canon mutation is out of scope.
Path contracts must reject path traversal and absolute host filesystem assumptions.
deferred_work: Storage writes if T005/T006 keep storage helper work decision/test-only.
context_tools_policy: T001 does not run context tools.
PHASE8-IMPL-001 T003 already produced a targeted context report.
Additional context tools are not needed for this parent unless a later child explicitly authorizes a narrow collect task.
Context output is evidence, not roadmap truth.
Roadmap truth remains roadmap_index.yaml, implementation_status.md, task records, enrichment JSON, and validation docs.
